    SELECT player_api_id, wins
    FROM player_stats
    ORDER BY wins DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
top_losses AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, losses
    FROM player_stats
    ORDER BY losses DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

FROM top_losses tl
JOIN Player p ON tl.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
